educational_overlay.purpose: Drafts structured, legally grounded pre-litigation demand notices detailing claims, breach chronologies, and statutory deadlines.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: When a client wishes to put a defaulting counterparty on notice prior to initiating litigation or arbitration.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: Where a pre-suit mediation clause mandates informal consultation prior to issuing formal legal notices.
educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Draft legal notice from {{CLAIMANT_NAME}} to {{DEFAULTING_PARTY}} demanding {{AMOUNT_DUE}} within {{CURE_PERIOD_DAYS}} days.
State contractual foundation, invoice chronology, failed demands, and accrued statutory interest.
State consequences of default: institution of commercial suit, attachment of assets, and legal costs.
Do not fabricate advocate registration details. Include [ADVOCATE VERIFICATION REQUIRED].
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: Sunrise Logistics transported 40 shipments of raw materials for Vanguard Manufacturing, but invoices from January to March 2026 remain unpaid despite multiple email reminders.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### LEGAL NOTICE (DEMAND)
Under Instructions from my Client, Sunrise Logistics Pvt Ltd...
1. That my Client performed transport services under Agreement dated...
2. Invoices totaling Rs. 18,50,000/- remain overdue...
3. You are hereby called upon to pay within 15 days, failing which commercial legal proceedings will ensue.
guardrails: Ensure demand does not make reckless criminal allegations in pure commercial debt disputes.
verification_checklist: Verify postal address and registered ROC office of counterparty.
Confirm interest rate is contractually backed or permitted under Interest Act 1978.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: Sending a defamatory or unsubstantiated notice exposes the claimant to counter-claims.
